spec.concept: Reentrancy: external calls can reenter before state is finalized
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows a contract box sending a call out to a second box, with an arrow looping back to the first box before the state box updates. Amber accents highlight the looping arrow and the state box. Clean lines, ample whitespace, calm engineering feel.
spec.overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
spec.alt_text: Diagram of one contract calling another, with an arrow looping back to the first contract before its state is updated, illustrating reentrancy.

spec.concept: Price oracle manipulation as a broken trust boundary: the protocol trusts price inputs that attackers can move.
spec.scene: Technical-style card on a deep navy background. A simple line diagram shows a price feed node connected to a contract node, with an amber dashed line marking the trust boundary between them. A small amber warning marker sits on the feed side. Clean, calm, precise layout with generous margins.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a price feed connected to a smart contract across a dashed amber line labeled as a trust boundary, with the text trust boundary.

spec.concept: Credibility through a simple, factual statement of audit experience from a smart contract audit firm.
spec.scene: A clean brand card with a deep navy background, a thin amber accent rule beneath the overlay text, and a minimal outline of a grove of stylized trees as a subtle watermark in the corner. Calm, precise, no clutter.
spec.alt_text: Brand card with navy background and white text reading 12 smart contract audits completed, with an amber accent line beneath.

spec.concept: A smart contract audit review that reports each finding with its severity, root cause and a recommended fix
spec.scene: Clean brand card on a deep navy background with a simple amber shield outline beside a short list of three finding lines, suggesting a structured audit report. Minimal, calm and engineering-focused, with generous spacing.
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber shield outline and a short list of report lines, with the text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.

spec.concept: Missing caller authorization lets anyone withdraw a contract's Ether; withdrawals should be restricted to authorized parties.
spec.scene: A calm, minimal brand card on a deep navy background with a simple vault outline whose door is held shut by a single amber key-shaped lock, with clean geometric lines and ample empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Brand image card with a navy background, an amber lock on a vault outline, and the text Restrict withdrawals to authorized parties.

spec.concept: ERC-4626 inflation attack: a direct donation to an empty vault inflates the share price so the next depositor's shares round down to zero.
spec.scene: Calm technical diagram on a deep navy background: a single vault box holding one glowing amber share, with a straight arrow labelled as a direct token transfer entering the vault, and a second smaller arrow showing a deposit that results in zero shares. Clean lines, minimal, no people.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a vault holding a single share while a direct token transfer inflates its value and a victim's deposit returns zero shares.
